description.en: The application ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query application IDs.

description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the invocation fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
description.en:
The project ID.  
1. You can log on to the [Internet of Things development console](https://account.aliyun.com/login/login.htm?qrCodeFirst=false&oauth_callback=https%3A%2F%2Fstudio.iot.aliyun.com%2F%3Fspm%3Da2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the corresponding instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click **Project Management** in the left-side navigation pane.  
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click the project card, and view the project ID in the address bar.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-studio-app-token-open --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --app-id a12000000 --project-id a1230000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GetStudioAppTokenOpen --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --AppId a12000000 --ProjectId a1230000000
